not all pages: out of memory
Pages, like on paper, with the layout of the original. Text flows to the width of the screen, easier to read on a phone. You can switch at any time in the document.
Material You: the app takes its accent colours from your wallpaper
Opens again only from that app
“%1$s” was opened from another app just once, so it can no longer be opened from the list. Open it again from that app or with “Open a file”.
A copy is kept in Hramota
Each paragraph follows the rules of its own language
This shelf is empty. Long-press a document on “All” and choose “Shelves…” to put it here.
Documents kept inside Hramota live here. Books arrive by themselves; any other document — through ⋮ → “Keep in Hramota”. Files you only opened are in Recent, and their bookmarks are remembered too.

Document memory, shelves, covers, kept copies and the recent list are encrypted with a key held in the phone’s secure hardware. Opening Hramota then asks for the phone’s screen lock; it locks again a minute after you leave. If the screen lock is removed, the locked data cannot be opened.
Set a screen lock on the phone first (PIN, pattern or password).
Your documents, shelves and notes open after the phone confirms it is you.
The phone’s PIN, pattern, password or fingerprint

One encrypted file with bookmarks, notes, reading places, shelves and settings, and the documents kept in Hramota if you choose. Save it wherever you like; restoring joins it with what is here and deletes nothing.
Bookmarks, notes, reading places, shelves and settings always go in.
Without the password the backup cannot be opened by anyone, you included: write it down.
What is in the backup is joined with what is here: nothing is deleted.
That did not work. Nothing was lost; try again.
The phone did not confirm it was you. Try the PIN, pattern or password.
The phone no longer has the key to the locked storage (its screen lock was removed or changed security). What was locked cannot be opened by anyone.
The locked memory, shelves and kept copies will be deleted. Documents in other places are not touched. If you have a backup, it can be restored afterwards.
Wrong password, or the backup is damaged
This is not a Hramota backup
Not enough room on the phone
Hramota locked in the meantime: unlock it and try again

Hramota will forget the recent list, bookmarks, notes, reading places and shelves, and delete the documents kept in it with their covers and the earlier versions kept from unfinished saves. Documents in other places on the phone are not touched.
Forget “%1$s”? Its bookmarks, notes and place are forgotten, and the copy kept in Hramota is deleted.
Remove “%1$s” from Hramota? The copy kept in Hramota is deleted; bookmarks and notes stay remembered for the original file.
These files are not a StarDict dictionary
No dictionaries yet. Add one in Settings → Dictionaries.
The highlights and notes become annotations other PDF apps show too. Into this file: the file itself changes. As a copy: the original stays as it was.
Could not save into this file; try “As a copy”

Dictionaries in the StarDict format (.ifo, .idx and .dict or .dict.dz, or a ZIP of them) that you add yourself. Select a word in a book or a document and choose “Dictionary”. Everything stays on the phone.
No documents on the shelf or in Recent yet.
This paragraph can’t be edited yet: it holds a picture, a field, tracked changes or something similar. It stays as it is.
This document can’t be edited here.
Couldn’t save. The changes are still here.
This file can’t be changed, so a copy with the changes was saved.
Couldn’t write into the file, and its earlier content couldn’t be put back either. The earlier version is kept in Hramota and offered on the home screen. Save the edited version as a copy now.
Couldn’t write into this file; it was left as it was. Save the changes as a copy.
This file can’t be changed here. Choose where to save a copy with your changes.
Saving “%1$s” did not finish. Its earlier version was kept in Hramota in case the file was damaged. Save it as a file?
Couldn’t save the earlier version. It is still kept.
Shown with the comment in Word. Can be left empty.
This comment is partly in a paragraph that can’t be edited here, so it can’t be deleted.
A copy with your changes was saved.
The locked storage is closed. Unlock Hramota and save again.
This paragraph can’t be edited yet: it holds a slide number, a date field, an equation or something similar. It stays as it is.
Saved as a new file; it opens now and can be edited. The old file stays as it was.
Couldn’t save in the new format.
Not saved: the file is too large to read in full, so the new file would be missing its end.

A new DOCX file is made; the old one stays as it is. Text, formatting, tables, pictures in the text, headers, footers and page size carry over; list numbers become text. Footnotes, comments, link addresses, text boxes, floating shapes, pictures in headers and nested tables do not; tab stops become left ones, and all sections take one orientation.

A new XLSX file is made; the old one stays as it is. Values, the look of cells, column widths, merged cells and hidden sheets carry over. Formulas keep only their results and the font becomes Calibri; charts, pictures and cell comments do not carry over.
Each document in its own window
A separate card in recent apps for every document. Off: documents open inside Hramota, and “back” returns to the home screen.
This workbook has charts, pivot tables, slicers or external data: rows can’t be inserted or deleted here, as those wouldn’t move with them.
This sheet has pictures, charts, notes, tables, controls or extended formatting: rows can’t be inserted or deleted here, as those wouldn’t move with them.
The workbook has array formulas, data tables or shared formulas over whole rows or columns: rows can’t be inserted or deleted here.
Some formulas refer to several sheets at once: rows aren’t inserted or deleted here.
The sheet is full to its last row: there is no room for another.
That file already exists: choose a new name.
